name: adv_junction_fluid_mixer_node
source:
// Fluid node with TWO inflows and one outflow, formed by connect (not by the
// Mixer component): does the node itself flow-weight the enthalpy?
Source SRC1(fluid$ = Water, mdot = 1.0, P = 300000, T = 300)
Source SRC2(fluid$ = Water, mdot = 3.0, P = 300000, T = 360)
Sink   SK()
connect(SRC1.out, SRC2.out, SK.in)
h1 = SRC1.out.h
h2 = SRC2.out.h
h3 = SK.in.h
m3 = SK.in.mdot

error.message: There are 18 equations and 16 variables. The problem is overspecified and cannot be solved. Redundant relations (no free variable left to determine): CONNECT src1.out, src2.out, sk.in: src1$out.p = src2$out.p; CONNECT src1.out, src2.out, sk.in: src1$out.h = src2$out.h. A common cause: the same physics stated twice — a boundary pinning a quantity a component already defines (a re-equated mixer pressure, a T-pinned wall state), or two property calls restating one relation.
